egress.terms: Metered: 2 TB / 4 TB / 8 TB per month on the 0.25 / 0.5 / 1 TB plans. No overage price published on the plan page. The 1 TB plan at 8 TB of transfer is a 8:1 ratio.

limits_note: per-object-cap: none. 200 IOPS on the 1 TB plan (from the billing cart). Port speed 100 Mbps.
reliability_note: Established Lithuanian host since 2013. The decisive fact is the pricing structure, not reliability.

extras.price_verbatim: $4.68/TB/mo on the promo (€4.17), **$9.38/TB/mo at renewal (€8.35)**. At 5 TB: five 1 TB plans at renewal = €41.75 = $46.90/mo = $9.38/TB.
